name: Mia
text: Dana is amazing at what she does. She always slays my nails and I walk loving them everytime. She has such great personal relationships with her clients and is truly the sweetest nail tech ever. Please come here to get your nails done!

name: A.B.
text: I recently moved to the area and have been looking to find a new nail salon: this is the one!! I booked a Saturday appointment about an hour before they opened & they quickly responded with confirmation! Got a simple gel manicure and it’s easily the best one I’ve ever received: my nail technician paid exceptional attention to the details (sizing, clean lines, etc) and was very gentle. With simple designs, all of those details matter and she did a wonderful job! Tons of compliments at my event that night and one day later I’m still admiring my nails against every surface I can find! The space itself is very welcoming, as were all members of the staff! I’m so pleased with the results and will 100% be returning here for any other manicure needs!

name: Nicole
text: **Update: I've been seeing Dana at her salon since December and I'm in awe of her talent and the care she puts into this business and her clients. She's becoming popular and busy so please make sure to make to make an appointment with them before coming in and I promise you it is worth it!** I don't even know where to start with this amazing review. I came to Dana's salon because I had tried a few salons here in the Valley and they were all so disappointing. I had been looking for a new salon for a couple months now. The other salons always rush, make you bleed, bully and make you feel bad about yourself. The moment I walked into Dana's salon I felt like I was at home. It's so welcoming, clean and beautiful. Dana is a small business owner and you can truly tell the love and hardwork she has put in to build her business. She is very educated and cares deeply about the work that is being done in her salon. I cannot wait to see how her business flourishes and grows because she truly deserves it. I have not been this happy with my nails or my experience at a salon in years. I can confidently say is you don't try this salon you are missing out.

name: Sunshine
text: I’ve been in here a few times for gel manicures, but this time I got a pedicure, and it was fantastic. Rayna made me feel comfortable and took good care of my cuticles and my gel polish. Never did French on my toes before, but she made it look really nice. And the massage was very relaxing.

name: Stacie
text: I do not usually take the time to write reviews, but Dana and her team absolutely deserve the recognition. From the moment you walk through the door, you feel welcomed, valued, and genuinely cared for. The space is immaculate, the attention to detail is unmatched, and the atmosphere radiates positive energy, which is such a gift in this day and age. Every interaction feels personal and thoughtful, and it is clear that they take pride in not only the quality of their work but also in creating an uplifting experience for their clients. You can truly see and feel the effort they put into going above and beyond in everything they do. I left feeling refreshed, appreciated, and already looking forward to my next visit. Dana and her team set the standard for what exceptional service should be!

name: Evie
text: I went to YoYo nails for the first time today and the service was amazing! I need to have short nails because I play piano, but I had a reference in mind for longer nails. My nail tech was Amanda and she did a wonderful job replicating it on my natural nails! I will definitely be returning.

name: Mary
text: go to this place! Dana smashes out my nails every time and they last forever - no chips here or broken nails here!!! Chloe is usually here when I come and she’s super bubbly, sweet, and always helps me pick a color. They overall create a great atmosphere that has me booking my next appointment before my other one is over! Great value and great people - defs worth checking out you won’t be disappointed

name: Angela
text: Overall a great experience. I scheduled an acrylic fill the night before and they confirmed my appointment right after opening the next morning. Toni was so kind! She removed my old gel mani and buffed my nails. Dana then took over, did the acrylic fill, shaped them, and applied the new gel polish. It was my first time going to YoYo and Dana was super excited to show me all of the beautiful glitter and chrome options they have! I tried chrome for the first time and Dana was just as excited about the end result as I was!! My only recommendation is to make sure to ask about pricing- the base for an acrylic fill is listed as $45, so I was expecting to pay around $60 total, but the full price came out to $75 for the fill + chrome. Not complaining, just explaining! Thank you so much to Toni and Dana I had such a lovely experience ✨💅
